title: Staging P2 Local Connector governed backup policy and apply approval readback

phases.objective: Introduce bounded SQL SELECT-only Staging authority adapter, fresh owner approval verification and synthetic trusted composition without any live DB backup, policy activation, QA writes or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Measured staging identity and injected read-only SQL policy client
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Owner-approved synthetic stream encrypted with fresh policy, approval and run readbacks and no real Staging DB mutation.
steps: Load exactly one policy and one independent backup_apply approval using parameterized SELECTs
Reject stale/revoked approvals, inactive or duplicate policy, unmeasured source, or unprepared apply run
Verify current source and policy state before calling the existing signed-envelope AES-GCM stream executor
Prove replay rejection and preserve all QA/Production mutation controls disabled
assertions: No SQL write, raw credential, cross-schema query, activation or provider mutation is created
A missing Staging SELECT grant blocks access rather than triggering a privilege escalation
Source, destination and owner approval must match the measured local connector identity
Synthetic ciphertext cannot be represented as an actual authorized Staging backup or restore
